body:
# **Pearls**
**Get the number of ender pearls that you have thrown are in the air right now, useful for checking if your chunk loaders all have pearls in them.** </br>
![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c9e7bd7d0b2419d0aa349317ad73cc490b3a82c.png) </br>
### **Commands:** 
**/Pearls - get number of pearls in the air [permission: pearls.use]**
### **Tested on 1.21.5 but should work on pretty much any version**
